---
title: "Living Document"
---

This guidebook is intended to be a living document that evolves alongside the needs and scope of the Living Data Project. If you have feedback or suggestions, please share them by using this [*Report an issue*](https://github.com/brcurrinder/ldp-data-rescue-guide/issues/new) link, which can also be found on the right side of any page, just below the chapter table of contents.

We welcome feedback that can help keep the guidebook useful, clear, and up to date.
